why: Analysis 1 matches the key more closely: its hedgehog names absorbent-fiber consumer brands including tissue with profit per consumer brand, and its stop-doing list exits the airline, newsprint and printing papers and plans separation of tobacco papers under a 'narrow it, don't reinvent it' verdict. Analysis 2 is better calibrated (explicit confidence statement, a sharper acquisition warning, no unsupported offer to schedule a re-check) but narrows the hedgehog to personal care with a 'category-leading brand' denominator and only holds tobacco papers pending data.
